title: Save Luke
statementMd:
Luke Skywalker got locked up in a rubbish shredder between two presses. R2D2 is already working on his rescue, but Luke needs to stay alive as long as possible. For simplicity we will assume that everything happens on a straight line, the presses are initially at coordinates $0$ and $*L*$, and they move towards each other with speed $*v*_{1}$ and $*v*_{2}$, respectively. Luke has width $*d*$ and is able to choose any position between the presses. Luke dies as soon as the distance between the presses is less than his width. Your task is to determine for how long Luke can stay alive.

## Input

The first line of the input contains four integers $*d*$, $*L*$, $*v*_{1}$, $*v*_{2}$ ($1 ≤ *d*, *L*, *v*_{1}, *v*_{2} ≤ 10 000, *d* < *L*$) — Luke's width, the initial position of the second press and the speed of the first and second presses, respectively.

## Output

Print a single real value — the maximum period of time Luke can stay alive for. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

## Note

In the first sample Luke should stay exactly in the middle of the segment, that is at coordinates $[2;4]$, as the presses move with the same speed.

In the second sample he needs to occupy the position ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/71395c777960eaded59a9fdc428a9625f152605b.png). In this case both presses move to his edges at the same time.
statementZhMd:
卢克·天行者被困在两个压板之间的垃圾粉碎机中。R2D2 已经开始营救他，但卢克需要尽可能长时间地存活。为简单起见，我们假设所有事情都发生在一条直线上，两个压板初始时分别位于坐标 $0$ 和 $*L*$，并分别以速度 $*v*_{1}$ 和 $*v*_{2}$ 相向移动。卢克的宽度为 $*d*$，并且可以选择位于两个压板之间的任意位置。当两个压板之间的距离小于他的宽度时，卢克就会死亡。你的任务是确定卢克能够存活多长时间。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含四个整数 $*d*$、$*L*$、$*v*_{1}$ 和 $*v*_{2}$（$1 ≤ *d*, *L*, *v*_{1}, *v*_{2} ≤ 10 000, *d* < *L*$）——卢克的宽度、第二个压板的初始位置，以及第一个和第二个压板的速度。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数——卢克能够存活的最长时间。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，标准答案为 $*b*$。评测程序将在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) 时判定你的答案正确。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，由于两个压板的速度相同，卢克应当正好待在这段线段的中间，也就是坐标为 $[2;4]$ 的位置。

在第二个样例中，他需要占据 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/71395c777960eaded59a9fdc428a9625f152605b.png) 所示的位置。在这种情况下，两个压板会同时移动到他的两侧。
